name: @deany/core
description: Infer strict TypeScript types from JSDoc and real usage evidence, eliminating any/implicit-any so code is ready for scriptc / tsc --strict.

scripts.demo: npm run build && node bin/deany.js examples/input.js -o examples/output.ts --check
scripts.infer-demo: npm run build && node bin/deany.js infer-any examples/any-input.ts -o examples/any-output.ts --check
scripts.js-infer-demo: npm run build && node bin/deany.js examples/js-infer-input.js -o examples/js-infer-output.ts --check
